title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: protect Recall snapshots on Copilot+ PCs
summary: Hold: the Purview creation path skips the template, device-location and rule choices needed to reach the Recall restriction. The documented behaviour and Windows policy controls are supported, but the briefing also understates the published Endpoint DLP licensing and omits Recall's preview qualification.

claims.quote: Select the Custom from the Categories then Custom policy template from Regulations. Select Next. ... Scope the location to only the Devices location. ... Create a rule with the following values:

claims.quote: DLP enforcement is applied at the window level—Recall removes only the specific window(s) identified by the DLP provider as containing sensitive data blocked by policy, while retaining the rest of the snapshot.
